item.title: Assignment of Specific Performance Decree Does Not Create Rights in Immovable Property; Registration Not Mandatory: SC
item.description: Supreme Court held that assignment of decree for specific performance is not compulsorily registrable under Section 17(1)(e) of the Registration Act

item.title: Central GST Team Raids Jalandhar’s Aggarwal Vaishno Dhaba Over Suspected GST Theft
item.description: GST officials raided Jalandhar’s Aggarwal Vaishno Dhaba and the owners’ homes over suspected GST theft.

item.title: ITAT Quashes CIT(A) Order for Lack of Natural Justice in Rs. 3.43 Lakh Expense Disallowance
item.description: ITAT Mumbai remanded the case after finding that the taxpayer was not given a fair chance to present evidence against the disallowance of business expenses.

item.title: Supreme Court Lays Down Uniform Seniority Framework for Higher Judicial Services Across India
item.description: Five-Judge Constitution Bench rejects “heartburn”-based claims and mandates a nationwide 4-point annual roster for District Judge seniority

item.title: ITAT Bangalore Excludes Multiple Comparables in SAP India TP Case; Upholds Interest on Receivables
item.description: Tribunal directs correction of Compucom Software margin, excludes four high-end comparables, and upholds separate benchmarking of overdue receivables

item.title: Delhi HC Orders Release of Marriage Gifts Detained by Customs: Waives warehousing charges
item.description: The Delhi High Court has recently directed the release of gold bangles and two iPhones detained by Customs upon the payment of a redemption fine, customs duty, and penalty.

item.title: Supreme Court Sets Aside HC’s Ex Parte Rejection of Title Suit; Plaint Not Time-Barred on Its Face
item.description: SC holds suit for possession based on title carries 12-year limitation; mutation does not confer title; plaint cannot be rejected under Order 7 Rule 11. HC orders set aside.

item.title: Receipt Remains Capital or Revenue Regardless of Utilisation: ITAT
item.description: ITAT Mumbai, has ruled in favour of an HUF, reducing the disallowance on exempt income and clarifying the nature of the refund of an advance payment made by the HUF to its Karta.

item.title: ITAT Delhi Quashes CPC’s Rs. 25 Lakh Addition; Allows Set-Off of STCL and LTCL Against Long-Term Gains
item.description: ITAT Delhi ruled that capital losses can be set off against long-term capital gains despite differing tax rates, quashing CPC and CIT(A)’s additions and restoring the taxpayer’s original income.

item.title: ITAT Ahmedabad Remands Addition of Rs. 1.70 Crore as Unexplained Investment for Fresh Verification
item.description: Tribunal sends matter back to AO after assessee produces Auto-Sweep account for the first time, which may alter the core factual findings
